urlencoded.label: repeated name keeps every value in order
brackets are part of the name
names keep the order of their first occurrence
plus is a space and percent sequences are bytes
a percent without two hexadecimal digits stays
a part without an equals sign has an empty value
the first equals sign separates the name
an empty name is a name
raw UTF-8 bytes are read as they are
a value that is not UTF-8 fails
a name that is not UTF-8 fails
a bracketed name that is not UTF-8 fails
a leading U+FEFF of a value is a character of the value

multipart.label: text fields in order with repeated and bracketed names
a file field is not a form value
a value keeps its line breaks and percent signs
a value that is not UTF-8 fails
files under one name keep their order
a file without a content type has an empty one
a file with an empty filename is still a file
a tab before the semicolon of the type is a blank
header names and form data are read without case
a lone line feed does not end a header line
a content type loses its spaces and tabs around it
a content type that ends with a no break space is not utf 8
a filename that is not utf 8 fails the text fields too
a token filename keeps its quote
a quoted filename keeps its backslashes
a quoted filename ends at its next quote
a header line that starts with the delimiter fails the body
bytes other than a line end after a delimiter fail the body
a part header of 8192 bytes is read
a part header of 8193 bytes fails the body
a part without an empty line and longer than 8192 bytes fails the body
an urlencoded type with a tab before its end is urlencoded
an urlencoded type with a parameter and another case is urlencoded
a body of another type has no values
an absent name has no values and a decimal name is a name
a body without its closing delimiter fails
a body that ends after a delimiter fails
the bytes before the first delimiter are ignored
the bytes after the closing delimiter are ignored
a delimiter inside a line of content is content
a line of content that starts with the delimiter and more fails the body
a part with empty content has the empty value
a name without quotes is a name
the text inside a quoted string is no parameter
a boundary inside a quoted string is no boundary
a Content-Type whose media type starts with the byte A0 fails with malformed_content_type (400)
a multipart/form-data type without a boundary fails with no_boundary (400)

streamed.label: a body read in chunks of seven bytes keeps its files in the directory
a body read byte by byte gives the same parts
a body read as one chunk gives the same parts
a multipart body of an application without that form type is one value

a stored file does not move to a path that exists

streamed.label: the text values of exactly the value limit are read
the text values of one byte more than the value limit stop the reading
a name alone that passes the value limit stops the reading
a file does not count for the value limit
a file of exactly the file limit is read
a file of one byte more than the file limit stops the reading and leaves no file
a text value does not count for the file limit
a part more than the part limit stops the reading also when it is neither a value nor a file
a body that is one value of exactly the value limit is held
a body that is one value of one byte more than the value limit stops the reading

uploaded.label: a file that an application makes holds its name, its filename, its content type and its bytes, and its size is the number of its bytes (F-22.2)
uploaded.name: upload

uploaded.label: a file made with the bytes FF 00 80 has the size 3 and returns the same bytes
uploaded.name: f

uploaded.label: a file made with the empty content type and no bytes has the size 0
uploaded.name: f

uploaded_file.move_to.name: upload

uploaded_file.move_to.label: a file that an application makes does not move to a path that exists, the directory of the call, and fails with exists (F-11)
uploaded_file.move_to.name: upload

uploaded_file.move_to.name: upload

uploaded_file.move_to.name: upload

uploaded_file.move_to.label: a move whose new file the system does not create fails with permission_denied and its errno EACCES, the kind of a refused access, and creates no file (F-11)

uploaded_file.move_to.label: a move whose new file the system does not create fails with storage_full and its errno ENOSPC, the kind of a full storage, and creates no file (F-11)

uploaded_file.move_to.name: upload

uploaded_file.move_to.name: upload

request_body.remove.label: a streamed body that was just made removes its directory (F-10)
a second removal of a streamed body that was removed does nothing and fails with no kind (F-10)
a removal of the directory of a request that the system fails fails with io and its errno, and the body is not removed (F-10)
a removal of the directory of a request that the system fails fails with not_found and its errno ENOENT, the kind of a path that does not exist, and the body is not removed (F-10)
a removal of the directory of a request that the system fails fails with permission_denied and its errno EACCES, the kind of a refused access, and the body is not removed (F-10)
a removal of the directory of a request that the system fails fails with storage_full and its errno ENOSPC, the kind of a full storage, and the body is not removed (F-10)

uploaded_file.content.label: the lock of a file that a panic left poisoned fails with internal, the class, kind and status of the error enum of http-form (X-1, H-8)
uploaded_file.content.name: upload

uploaded_file.content.stored.label: the content of a stored file after its move fails with moved (F-11)
the content of a stored file whose read the system fails with EIO fails with io and its errno (F-11)
the content of a stored file whose read the system fails with ENOENT fails with not_found and its errno (F-11)
the content of a stored file whose read the system fails with EACCES fails with permission_denied and its errno (F-11)
the content of a stored file whose read the system fails with ENOSPC fails with storage_full and its errno (F-11)
the content of a stored file after the removal of its body fails with removed (F-9, F-11)

uploaded_file.move_to.stored.label: a stored file that moved fails a second move with moved (F-11)
a move to another file system whose copy is done but whose source the system does not remove fails with source_left and the errno of the removal (F-11)
a move to another file system whose copy fails with ENOSPC and whose target the system does not remove fails with partial_target and the errno of the copy (F-11)
a stored file after the removal of its body fails a move with removed (F-9, F-11)
